# Resource: stripe_treasury_debit_reversal

The reversal of a received debit, which returns the money to the Treasury financial account. Treasury runs on a platform's connected accounts, so manage debit reversals through a provider configuration whose `stripe_account` is the connected account. Stripe reverses a received debit only once, and only while its `reversal_details.restricted_reason` is null. Stripe moves a new reversal from `processing` to `succeeded` by itself within seconds, and only then sets its `transaction`. A reversal cannot be canceled, and nothing changes after creation.

~> A treasury debit reversal can move real money. In a live-mode Stripe account, creating or changing one fails at plan time unless the provider sets `allow_live_money_movement = true`. Reading or importing one never does. The provider asks Stripe for the account's mode. See the Managing Test Data guide.

~> Stripe cannot delete or cancel a debit reversal. `terraform destroy`, and a change that would replace the treasury debit reversal, fail at plan time. To stop managing a treasury debit reversal, remove it from the state as [Removing from State](#removing-from-state) shows; it stays in the Stripe account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "treasury_account" {
  type        = string
  description = "A connected account with the treasury capability active."
}

variable "received_debit" {
  type        = string
  description = "A received debit of one of the connected account's financial accounts."
}

# Treasury runs on a connected account, so a second provider configuration acts on it.
provider "stripe" {
  alias          = "treasury"
  stripe_account = var.treasury_account
}

resource "stripe_treasury_debit_reversal" "disputed" {
  provider       = stripe.treasury
  received_debit = var.received_debit
  metadata = {
    reason = "not authorized"
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `received_debit` - (Required) The ReceivedDebit to reverse. Changing it fails the plan, because this resource cannot be replaced.

The following arguments are optional:

* `metadata` - (Optional) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`. Changing it fails the plan, because this resource cannot be replaced.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `amount` - Amount (in cents) transferred.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `currency` - Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
* `financial_account` - The FinancialAccount to reverse funds from.
* `hosted_regulatory_receipt_url` - A [hosted transaction receipt](https://docs.stripe.com/treasury/moving-money/regulatory-receipts) URL that is provided when money movement is considered regulated under Stripe's money transmission licenses.
* `linked_flows` - Other flows linked to a DebitReversal. See [`linked_flows`](#linked_flows) below.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `network` - The rails used to reverse the funds. Possible values: `ach`, `card`.
* `status` - Status of the DebitReversal Possible values: `failed`, `processing`, `succeeded`.
* `status_transitions` - See [`status_transitions`](#status_transitions) below.
* `transaction` - The Transaction associated with this object.

<a id="linked_flows"></a>
### `linked_flows`

The `linked_flows` attribute supports:

* `issuing_dispute` - Set if there is an Issuing dispute associated with the DebitReversal.

<a id="status_transitions"></a>
### `status_transitions`

The `status_transitions` attribute supports:

* `completed_at` - Timestamp describing when the DebitReversal changed status to `completed`.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)

## Removing from State

To stop managing a treasury debit reversal whose destroy is refused, remove it from the state without destroying it. In Terraform 1.7 and later, and OpenTofu 1.10 and later, replace the `resource` block with a [`removed` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/removed) and apply:

```terraform
removed {
  from = stripe_treasury_debit_reversal.disputed

  lifecycle {
    destroy = false
  }
}
```

Using `terraform state rm`:

```console
% terraform state rm stripe_treasury_debit_reversal.disputed
```

The treasury debit reversal stays in the Stripe account. Replacing one with `terraform apply -replace` or `terraform taint` fails in the same way, at apply.

## Import

Run the import where the resource's `provider` acts on the connected account that holds it.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a treasury debit reversal using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_treasury_debit_reversal.disputed
  id = "debrev_1MtX7tLkdIwHu7ixKY1yCbsS"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_treasury_debit_reversal.disputed
  identity = {
    id = "debrev_1MtX7tLkdIwHu7ixKY1yCbsS"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the treasury debit reversal.

Using `terraform import`, import a treasury debit reversal using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_treasury_debit_reversal.disputed debrev_1MtX7tLkdIwHu7ixKY1yCbsS
```
